definitions.gloss: sound truck; van fitted with loudspeakers for street campaigning
definitions.explanation: A vehicle equipped with loudspeakers used to broadcast political messages on the street. The word most often calls to mind the black vans of right-wing groups, but it also covers the campaign vans used by candidates during elections.

examples.japanese: {街宣車|がいせんしゃ}がうるさい。
{駅前|えきまえ}に{街宣車|がいせんしゃ}が{止|と}まっている。
examples.english: A sound truck is parked in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {選挙|せんきょ}が{近|ちか}づくと、{候補者|こうほしゃ}の{街宣車|がいせんしゃ}が{町中|まちじゅう}を{走|はし}り{回|まわ}る。
examples.english: As the election approaches, the candidates' sound trucks drive all over town.

notes:
Made up of {街頭|がいとう} (on the street) + {宣伝|せんでん} (publicity) + {車|しゃ} (vehicle).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {街宣車|がいせんしゃ}が{回|まわ}る: a sound truck drives around
- {街宣車|がいせんしゃ}の{音|おと}: the noise from a sound truck
- {右翼|うよく}の{街宣車|がいせんしゃ}: a right-wing sound truck
- {選挙|せんきょ}カー: election campaign car — the neutral term used at election time

CULTURAL CONTEXT:
Black {街宣車|がいせんしゃ} playing military music and slogans at high volume are a familiar sight near stations and government offices in Japanese cities. Because of that association the word carries a faintly negative tone, so news coverage of ordinary campaigning usually prefers {選挙|せんきょ}カー.
